rows.label: GUARANI

rows.label: HEADWAY

rows.label: FARAD

rows.label: CENTILITER

rows.label: FOOTER

rows.label: TEACUPFUL
rows.clue: As much as a teacup will hold

rows.label: ARMFUL
rows.clue: The quantity that can be contained in the arms

rows.label: THIRD POWER
rows.clue: The product of three equal terms

rows.label: AUSTRAL
rows.clue: The basic unit of money in Argentina

rows.label: LIQUID UNIT
rows.clue: A unit of capacity for liquids (for measuring the volumes of liquids or their containers)

rows.label: SQUARE INCH
rows.clue: A unit of area equal to one inch by one inch square

rows.label: PRINTING UNIT
rows.clue: A unit of measurement for printing

rows.label: QUART

rows.label: PRECIPITATION

rows.label: MARKKA
rows.clue: Formerly the basic unit of money in Finland

rows.label: CUTOFF
rows.clue: A designated limit beyond which something cannot function or must be terminated

rows.label: FRANC
rows.clue: The basic monetary unit in many countries

rows.label: BIRDIE
rows.clue: (golf) a score of one stroke under par on a hole

rows.label: SOUND UNIT
rows.clue: Any acoustic unit of measurement

rows.label: RUPEE
rows.clue: The basic unit of money in Sri Lanka

rows.label: HOUSEROOM
rows.clue: Space for accommodation in a house

rows.label: KRONE
rows.clue: The basic unit of money in Norway

rows.label: ORDINAL
rows.clue: The number designating place in an ordered sequence

rows.label: FORTY
rows.clue: The cardinal number that is the product of ten and four

rows.label: CATTY
rows.clue: Any of various units of weight used in southeastern Asia (especially a Chinese measure equal to 500 grams)

rows.label: MINIMUM
rows.clue: The smallest possible quantity

rows.label: VOLUME UNIT
rows.clue: A unit of measurement of volume or capacity

rows.label: QUIRE
rows.clue: A quantity of paper

rows.label: ANGULAR UNIT
rows.clue: A unit of measurement for angles

rows.label: BODY LENGTH
rows.clue: The length of your body

rows.label: HUNDREDWEIGHT
rows.clue: A unit of weight equal to 100 kilograms

rows.label: LITER

rows.label: FIFTH PART
rows.clue: One part in five equal parts

rows.label: BINARY DIGIT
rows.clue: Either 0 or 1 in binary notation

rows.label: DOSAGE
rows.clue: The quantity of an active agent (substance or radiation) taken in or absorbed at any one time

rows.label: EIGHTEEN

rows.label: MASS UNIT
rows.clue: A unit of measurement for mass

rows.label: FISTFUL
rows.clue: The quantity that can be held in the hand

rows.label: NUMERATOR

rows.label: BAD BLOCK
rows.clue: (computer science) a block (usually one sector) that cannot reliably hold data

rows.label: GOURDE
rows.clue: The basic unit of money in Haiti

rows.label: TWENTY
rows.clue: The cardinal number that is the sum of nineteen and one

rows.label: MAGNETIC FLUX
rows.clue: A measure of the strength of a magnetic field over a given area

rows.label: LIGHT HOUR
rows.clue: The distance light travels in a vacuum in one hour

rows.label: GRAM CALORIE

rows.label: BALBOA
rows.clue: The basic unit of money in Panama

rows.label: KARAT
rows.clue: The unit of measurement for the proportion of gold in an alloy

rows.label: SCOOPFUL
rows.clue: The quantity a scoop will hold

rows.label: BREAKAGE
rows.clue: The quantity broken

rows.label: SMALL FORTUNE
rows.clue: A large sum of money

rows.label: MODICUM
rows.clue: A small or moderate or token amount

rows.label: QUADRILLION
rows.clue: The number that is represented as a one followed by 24 zeros

rows.label: POTFUL
rows.clue: The quantity contained in a pot

rows.label: IMAGINARY PART
rows.clue: The part of a complex number that has the square root of -1 as a factor

rows.label: BASINFUL
rows.clue: The quantity that a basin will hold

rows.label: DRY PINT
rows.clue: A United States dry unit equal to 0.5 quart or 33.6 cubic inches

rows.label: SOLUBILITY
rows.clue: The quantity of a particular substance that can dissolve in a particular solvent (yielding a saturated solution)

rows.label: CHARGE UNIT
rows.clue: A measure of the quantity of electricity (determined by the amount of an electric current and the time for which it flows)

rows.label: DENOMINATOR
rows.clue: The divisor of a fraction

rows.label: LIGHT YEAR
rows.clue: The distance that light travels in a vacuum in 1 year

rows.label: SHIPLOAD
rows.clue: The amount of cargo that can be held by a boat or ship or a freight car

rows.label: SEVENTEEN
rows.clue: The cardinal number that is the sum of sixteen and one

rows.label: WELTERWEIGHT
rows.clue: A weight of 28 pounds

rows.label: DOUBLE EAGLE
rows.clue: (golf) a score of three strokes under par on a hole

rows.label: CABLE LENGTH
rows.clue: A nautical unit of depth

rows.label: RINGGIT
rows.clue: The basic unit of money in Malaysia

rows.label: PESETA
rows.clue: Formerly the basic unit of money in Spain

rows.label: THIMBLEFUL
rows.clue: As much as a thimble will hold

rows.label: LIGHT MINUTE
rows.clue: The distance light travels in a vacuum in one minute

rows.label: BLOOD COUNT
rows.clue: The number of red and white corpuscles in a blood sample

rows.label: CUBE ROOT
rows.clue: A number that when multiplied three times equals a given number

rows.label: DECILITER
rows.clue: A metric unit of volume equal to one tenth of a liter

rows.label: ASTRONOMY UNIT
rows.clue: A linear unit used for astronomical distances

rows.label: DRY UNIT
rows.clue: A unit of capacity for dry commodities (as fruit or grain)

rows.label: HORSEPOWER
rows.clue: A unit of power equal to 746 watts

rows.label: TABLESPOONFUL
rows.clue: As much as a tablespoon will hold

rows.label: METER
rows.clue: The basic unit of length adopted under the Systeme International d'Unites (approximately 1.094 yards)

rows.label: NINETEEN
rows.clue: The cardinal number that is the sum of eighteen and one

rows.label: LIGHT UNIT
rows.clue: A measure of the visible electromagnetic radiation

rows.label: GEOMETRIC PACE
rows.clue: A modern version of the Roman pace now taken to be 5 feet

rows.label: ACID VALUE
rows.clue: (chemistry) the amount of free acid present in fat as measured by the milligrams of potassium hydroxide needed to neutralize it

rows.label: MAGNETIZATION
rows.clue: The extent or degree to which something is magnetized

rows.label: SPOILAGE
rows.clue: The amount that has spoiled

rows.label: ELECTRON VOLT
rows.clue: A unit of energy equal to the work done by an electron accelerated through a potential difference of 1 volt

rows.label: BOARD FOOT
rows.clue: The volume of a piece of wood 1 foot square and 1 inch thick

rows.label: ROENTGEN
rows.clue: A unit of radiation exposure

rows.label: RUBLE
rows.clue: The basic unit of money in Tajikistan

rows.label: SWATH
rows.clue: The space created by the swing of a scythe or the cut of a mowing machine

rows.label: TRACE
rows.clue: A just detectable amount

rows.label: HANDFUL
rows.clue: A small number or amount

rows.label: RADIAN
rows.clue: The unit of plane angle adopted under the Systeme International d'Unites

rows.label: SCATTERING
rows.clue: A small number (of something) dispersed haphazardly

rows.label: GAS CONSTANT
rows.clue: (physics) the universal constant in the gas equation: pressure times volume = R times temperature

rows.clue: A unit of astronomical length based on the distance from Earth at which stellar parallax is 1 second of arc
